observation: The graph files are written by a project output module, not the framework file target. write_annotated_graph and write_facts_graph are two instances of one component: they read the declared graph-record artifacts, stamp kind and component the way the framework writer does, and differ in one configuration bit, whether the four annotation fields are written. project_kept_records now only filters verdict = keep and keeps the schema, so every downstream consumer reads one schema; the omission of the annotation from graph.jsonl happens at the file boundary. The framework patches that taught Neo4j and the meta-graph to tolerate a narrowed view are reverted.
